summary: Full regression of the Phase-1 refinement (logo + settings menu/theme/locale + scroll canvas sequence + copy edits + footer restructure + resend-notification). Backend pytest 12/12 pass. Frontend desktop + mobile verified end-to-end: nav-logo present beside YUE FUNG wordmark, exactly 1 H1, 0 'Sign in', 0 placeholder-tag elements. Copy edits live ('40 Years Manufacturing Pedigree since 1984', 'Heritage' / 'Consistently provides you with long-term operational security.', 'Your Specifications. Our Expertise.', 'A Standard That Lasts'). Settings menu opens, theme-dark sets documentElement.dataset.theme='dark' and persists across reload; theme-light reverts. All 5 locales (en/zh/zh-TW/cs/es) switch nav + hero H1 + section headings + inquiry form labels, set documentElement.lang to en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant/cs/es correctly, persist across reload. CS long heading renders with 0 horizontal overflow. ScrollSequence: scroll-sequence + sequence-canvas render, pixel data differs between two scroll positions (8,7,1,255 -> 45,45,45,255) proving frame advance; page scroll is NOT hijacked (capabilities section remains reachable); no console errors. prefers-reduced-motion:reduce switches to sequence-poster (canvas disappears). Footer: 5 category footer-link-* in a row, 'Company address' label present, year 2026 shown, privacy link navigates to /privacy and translates on locale change. Service prefill still works (tooling button -> select-service='tooling'). Validation: empty submit shows inline errors in English and in zh (first error '请填写联系人姓名'). Happy path submission with delivered@resend.dev + unique timestamped description + test.pdf -> success panel with reference YF-2610-3C7AF (saved despite notification email being 'partial' / 502 as expected). Mobile 390x844: hamburger + mobile-menu open and navigate, settings-btn reachable and functional, scroll-sequence canvas renders, 0 horizontal overflow. Admin dashboard: inquiries-table lists rows, detail panel shows 'Notification email: partial' + 'Delivery error: company notification: 502: Failed to send email', resend-notification-btn calls API 200 and shows 'Delivery partial' toast. Auth gating verified via direct API: POST /api/inquiries/{id}/resend-notification -> 401 (no auth), 403 (visitor), 200 (admin).
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsMenu does not auto-close after selecting a locale/theme. Not a bug, but makes automation harder — pattern of 'click settings-btn then click locale-x-btn' fails on the 2nd iteration because the menu is still open and settings-btn toggles it closed. Consider calling setOpen(false) inside setLocale/setTheme handlers.

form.reset() cannot be relied on to clear a controlled React <select>; after service prefill the select-service value remains, so a subsequent empty submit shows 5 inline errors instead of 6. This is an automation nuance, not a functional bug.
